label: The newer Figma skill makes diagram loading a hard precondition on every generate_diagram call and asks when architecture and flowchart are both plausible, stronger than the packet load rule.
Four universal constraints the packet lacks: quoted special characters, stripped sequence notes, stripped gantt styling, and FigJam-only APIs in extensions with no createPage.
The corpus names generator limits as a user hand-off: can-not change fonts, move shapes or edit node by node, so edit in Figma or regenerate; the packet only forbids moving nodes.
The newer commit adds a FigJam node API surface with sections, tables, code blocks, labels, stickies, connectors and batch modify; the packet extension surface is narrower.
plan-board-content makes board layout measurable: 4px spacing multiples, tight/loose/zone distance bands, a type scale, a white wrapper section and fixed sticky sizes.
The corpus documents placing a generated diagram inside a board section, including reparenting every node and delete-and-recreate for long-bend connectors; the packet never-move rule blocks it.
The corpus contradicts itself on the generate_diagram schema: mermaidSyntax in the skill versus mermaid plus editorType in the project-plan block, supporting the packet runtime schema check.
skills-figquery is a byte-identical redistribution of skills for the diagram skill, adding packaging reach rather than a second opinion.
The packet beats Figma own skill on provenance: five source classes, an authority order and conflict gate, and status labels on proposal or unknown claims, against a plain do-not-invent instruction.
The packet beats Figma own skill on pre-write verification: the corpus has no model checker and only reacts after generation, while the packet refuses a model the check failed.
The corpus ships the base diagram link before extensions and treats partial extension failure as progress; the packet delivers once after every step.
The corpus ranks hybrid extension value by type: flowchart annotation first, ERD domain colouring second, sequence/state/gantt conservative; the packet has no per-type extension triage.
